title: Hotel Kempenrust
description: During this team project, we developed a new website for the swimming pool at Hotel Kempenrust. I worked in a team of six students and had the opportunity to serve as the Scrum Master! Read this page to view my contribution to the website.

pageDetails.title: Swim lesson overview
pageDetails.description: The teacher can change the hour or cancel a lesson if needed, or take a look at everyone who will attend a specific lesson. The teacher can choose a lesson here.

pageDetails.title: Swim lesson appointments
pageDetails.description: On this page, the teacher can view all the appointments that are made for a specific swimming lesson during the week. This includes the children that will attend the lessons.

pageDetails.title: Swim lesson changes
pageDetails.description: This is where the teacher can actually change details from lessons.

pageDetails.title: Manage swim lesson
pageDetails.description: The manager from the swimming pool can change lesson specific details permanently, not for one week like the teacher; these changes are made permanently.

pageDetails.title: Pop ups
pageDetails.description: I created a lot of pop-ups that add functionality to the pages. Here are some examples.

techStackDetails.title: TALL-stack
techStackDetails.description: After the prototypes were created in Figma, we used TALL-stack, which is Tailwind CSS, AlpineJS, Laravel and Livewire.

techStackDetails.title: Laravel
techStackDetails.description: Both the front- & back-end are created using Laravel. Tailwind makes styling easy while Alpine makes the design interactive. Livewire & Laravel make it possible to program everything with PHP instead of using full JS, and add the MVC pattern. Alpine fills the gaps.
